nodes.label: PayHere
nodes.rationale: Signature verification is required before trusting any webhook status update, to prevent marking a Purchase as completed based on unverified data; current PayHere docs must always be checked rather than assumed for the hash/signature format.

nodes.label: Branding Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Tone is calm/trustworthy rather than playful because parents often pay for the platform, so the visual tone should read as credible and serious, similar to a tuition institute's materials rather than a consumer/gamified app.

nodes.label: Department of Examinations Sri Lanka
nodes.rationale: Past exam paper content sourcing/copyright is an open item with this Department; flag if any prompt seems to assume unrestricted redistribution rights.

nodes.label: Payment Webhook Signature Verification Guardrail
nodes.rationale: Payment webhook handling must verify PayHere's signature before trusting any status update; do not mark a Purchase as completed without signature verification, preventing fraudulent completed purchases.

nodes.label: Never Commit Secrets Guardrail (auth.json, .env)
nodes.rationale: auth.json (the Flux Pro license file) and .env must never be committed and must be in .gitignore, to avoid leaking license keys and secrets.

nodes.label: Server-side Scoring Convention
nodes.rationale: All scoring logic runs server-side inside the Livewire component's PHP; a score value posted from the client must never be trusted, preventing quiz score tampering.

nodes.label: Laravel Boost
nodes.rationale: Provides agents 15+ tools and skills to help AI coding agents build Laravel applications while following best practices, installed via composer require laravel/boost --dev and php artisan boost:install.
